// diagnostic

E1360

An inline `package { … }` declaration must be the first top-level declaration.

What

An inline `package { … }` declaration must be the first top-level declaration.

Why

The contextual package carrier owns the file's Package facts and must be established before ordinary Jet items.

Fix

Move the `package { … }` block before every other top-level declaration.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1360: tests/ui/inline_package_not_first.stderr.

Error [E1360]: An inline `package { … }` declaration must be the first top-level declaration.
  --> tests/ui/inline_package_not_first.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | package { name: "demo" }
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The contextual package carrier owns the file's Package facts and must be established before ordinary Jet items.
 Fix: Move the `package { … }` block before every other top-level declaration.
